reply_ideas.reply_text: The courage part is real. It's a lot easier to stay cool and unbothered than to say out loud that you love something and risk it not working out. The people I like being around most say it anyway.
Writing is the only way I can tell whether I actually understand something or just like how it sounds in my head. The page is a lot less polite.
So much of it seems to come down to being okay with the quiet after you ask. Filling that silence too fast is where a lot of people talk themselves down.

x_posts.title: Small-wins pattern: not for anyone else
x_posts.text:
Nobody else is going to notice the small stuff. Putting the dishes away, answering the one email you've been avoiding, writing the date at the top of the page.

That's fine. They aren't for anyone else.

They're how you find out you're someone who keeps going.
